metrics.basis: Combined heavy resistance + short-sprint exposure improves sprint performance by roughly 1-3% over 8-12 weeks in trained team-sport athletes (plyometric/sprint training meta-analyses, e.g. Saez de Villarreal, Requena & Cronin 2012, JSCR 26(2)). We take the LOW end, and only when both the heavy contrast and the acceleration circuit are actually prescribed.
Vision PlayerLoad is arbitrary units (Boyd, Ball & Aughey 2011, IJSPP 6(3)); only the within-system trend is meaningful. Small positive delta declared, explicitly low confidence.
Maximal-velocity exposure plus olympic-pull RFD work. Same 1-3% literature band as r_acceleration_deficit, low end taken. Halved above 8.8 m/s: the closer to the ceiling, the smaller the return.
Repeated-sprint training improves repeated-sprint output; the match-total metric it is projected onto is also driven by tactical context, so the delta is deliberately small.
COD-specific drilling plus unilateral strength improves 505 performance by a few percent over a block; we project the reorientation-rate proxy, not a 505 time.

metrics.basis: Combined heavy resistance + short-sprint exposure improves sprint performance by roughly 1-3% over 8-12 weeks in trained team-sport athletes (plyometric/sprint training meta-analyses, e.g. Saez de Villarreal, Requena & Cronin 2012, JSCR 26(2)). We take the LOW end, and only when both the heavy contrast and the acceleration circuit are actually prescribed.
Vision PlayerLoad is arbitrary units (Boyd, Ball & Aughey 2011, IJSPP 6(3)); only the within-system trend is meaningful. Small positive delta declared, explicitly low confidence.
Maximal-velocity exposure plus olympic-pull RFD work. Same 1-3% literature band as r_acceleration_deficit, low end taken. Halved above 8.8 m/s: the closer to the ceiling, the smaller the return.
Repeated-sprint training improves repeated-sprint output; the match-total metric it is projected onto is also driven by tactical context, so the delta is deliberately small.
COD-specific drilling plus unilateral strength improves 505 performance by a few percent over a block; we project the reorientation-rate proxy, not a 505 time.

projected_detail.score_sensitivity_disclosure: These weights are NOT empirical. They are a declared, monotone, deliberately shallow map from projected metric deltas to the 0-100 scores, so the pitch can show a coherent before/after without inventing a second model. Score deltas are capped hard.
projected_detail.note: Every projection is a conservative point estimate with no interval. The literature ranges they are drawn from are group means from other cohorts under other conditions. They are a planning aid, not a forecast.
